messages:
raj: quick FYI: onboarding sampleapp SSE stream goes silent after ~30s, client stays OPEN and never reconnects. repro on mac and CI runner.
ellie: which sdk/sampleapp?
raj: node quickstart using eventsource-polyfill. Happens in browser + headless. no console errors, just silence. :thinking_face:
samir: likely keepalive vs auth refresh at proxy. any 401s?
raj: none. local runner logs around stall:
raj: [2026-03-17T21:03:12Z] stream: send keepalive
raj: [2026-03-17T21:03:42Z] auth: refresh start
raj: [2026-03-17T21:03:42Z] proxy: upgrade ok
raj: [2026-03-17T21:03:42Z] stream: received blank chunk (

)
raj: [2026-03-17T21:03:42Z] auth: refresh done
raj: [2026-03-17T21:03:45Z] stream: no data for 10s, client still reports OPEN
ellie: blank chunk = lone CRLF. our SSE parser treats that as keepalive, but if proxy pauses and later splices a blank chunk with next data frame we can clobber last-event-id and lose reassembly. client won't see a close so no reconnect.
raj: what's a quick fix?
samir: client watchdog: track last event timestamp and if > (2x keepalive) do es.close() + new EventSource(url). very small change to sampleapp.
ellie: yep add WATCHDOG env and README note: "If you see silent stalls during onboarding, enable WATCHDOG or increase keepalive." I'll draft patch.
raj: sample current snippet:
raj: const es = new EventSource(url); es.onmessage = (e) => console.log('msg', e.data); es.onopen = () => console.log('open'); es.onerror = () => console.log('err');
samir: add setInterval to check lastSeen and recreate ES. I'll draft that in PR.
ellie: server-side option: emit SSE comment on auth refresh ":auth-refresh start/end" so clients observe activity.
samir: server comment is useful but fragile across proxies; prefer client watchdog + optional server signal.
devex-bot: @samir opened PR draft https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapps/pull/512 adding watchdog + README note. :rocket:
ellie: also add a tiny CI test simulating blank chunk during auth refresh (netcat-based) to assert client reconnects.
raj: adding repro script and logs to PR.
samir: will add flaky-tolerant netcat test and docs about client libs that collapse blank lines vs keepalive.
ellie: merging README+watchdog after CI. closing onboarding ticket once staged. :white_check_mark:
raj: thanks all, saved my onboarding call earlier.
